comment: Hackathon Strategist context registry. Personas are runtime agent definitions (.agents/personas/); rules always apply; skills are Strategist-specific procedures. The shared vendor catalog lives in launchpad-ts/.agents — not duplicated here. Detailed contracts: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

references: IMPORTANT: launchpad-ts/.agents hosts the shared vendor catalog (personas, skills, spec-kit). Reference, never duplicate.

personas.description: Owns the run: stage transitions, budget governor, gate keeper, event-bus publisher, human-directive ingestion, escalation. The conductor of the deliberation.
Extracts event format, duration, tracks, tech requirements, submission rules, and dates from the ingested event website.
Researches sponsors (industries, goals, tracks, prizes), judges' backgrounds, and the audience profile; produces a stakeholder scorecard.
Analyzes what won this or similar events and why: patterns in domain, tech, production quality, and demo-ability, with citations.
Profiles provided datasets (schema, size, quality, distribution, signals) and maps which solution classes the data enables or precludes.
Divergent generation of 10-20 candidate idea cards spanning safe to bold, each mapped verbatim to the problem statement.
Adversarial critique of every candidate against research findings; forces rebuttals and kills weak ideas with cited reasons.
Applies reviewer feedback and human directives, runs the weighted scoring model, drives the loop, and drafts the markdown artifacts.
Rubric & gating expert: owns the event's scoring sheet (RUBRIC.md) and gating rules; returns criterion-by-criterion Approve/Revise verdicts.
Reviews each candidate from the sponsors' perspective: stated goals, challenge tracks, and prize criteria.
Reviews each candidate from the event audience/end-user perspective: demo-compelling, adoptable, first-paint wow.
Product/project manager lens: MVP decomposition, effort vs the build window and team size/skills, scope-cut proposals, risk flags.

skills.name: web-ingest
skills.description: Fetch and normalize hackathon website content: boilerplate stripping, nested/paginated pages, agenda/tracks/past-winners capture, cache.

skills.name: data-analysis
skills.description: Profile provided datasets (csv/json/xlsx/pdf): schema, size, quality, distribution, signals, and a solution-leverage map.

skills.name: debate-protocol
skills.description: Run a structured debate round: critique, rebuttal, scoring, reviewer verdicts, feedback-to-revision traceability, termination rules.

routing.comment: Task → context. Rules always apply. Shared/generic skills come from launchpad-ts.
